_doc: Output writer settings. by_agent: write timeline_by_agent/<agent_id>.csv. parquet: write timeline/contacts/room_exposure .parquet mirrors. by_agent_max_open: keep one open file per agent up to this many agents, else buffer in memory (by_agent_buffer_mb) and append. gzip_level: zlib level for .csv.gz (mock used 9; 6 is ~as small and much faster). gzip_threads: parallel deflate workers (output is one standard gzip member, byte-identical for any thread count). chunk_rows: rows formatted per batch (memory bound). R_window_days: override for measured_R eligibility window (null = latent+presym+infectious means from cfg.disease). R_min_agents: below this N the summary carries a note that R is not meaningful.
